title: WenHai-E2E: end-to-end machine learning for global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts
summary: The November 13, 2026 paper introduces WenHai-E2E, which generates global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts directly from observations and reports better forecast accuracy than a numerical system. The abstract and publication metadata reviewed here identify no separate oceanographic discovery or specific field result beyond forecast performance. Full text was not assessed.
